pricing_notice: Published prices and reserved durations from Mane Haven Salon public booking menu. A + means starting price. Final total may change with product or scope; verify in booking flow.

policy.address: 1615 SW Main St. Suite 104a, Ankeny, IA 50023
policy.cancellation: At least 24 hours notice requested for cancellation or rescheduling. Cancellation within 24 hours carries a 50% fee for the booked service, payable before future bookings.
policy.preparation: For color, be ready to describe prior dyes, bleach, treatments, and desired result; bring inspiration photos if helpful.

services.name: Full Foil
services.best_for: Full blonde refresh, major change, new color client, or very thick hair
services.includes: Color appointment has time for haircut; 2 bowls of color and toner
services.notes: Additional color bowls $15 each; hair condition and prior color may require consultation.

services.name: Maintenance Foil
services.best_for: Existing color client refreshing highlights or lived-in color and dimension
services.includes: Time for haircut; 1 bowl of color and toner
services.notes: Stylist decides half-head versus partial foil during appointment; additional color bowls $15 each.

services.name: Face Frame Foil
services.best_for: Small pop of brightness around the face, up to 10 foils
services.includes: Time for haircut; 1 bowl of color and toner

services.name: Sparkle Coverage
services.includes: 1 bowl of color and toner to refresh ends

services.name: All Over Color
services.notes: Not a blonding service; additional bowls $15 each.

services.name: Haircut
services.best_for: Haircut at or below chin length
services.notes: Salon does not accept above-chin cuts, kids cuts, clipper cuts, or barbering.

services.name: Gloss Treatment
services.best_for: Tone, darken, or add shine between larger color appointments
services.notes: Does not replace a lightening service.

services.name: Blow Out
services.best_for: Wash and style for an occasion or routine visit
services.includes: Wash and chosen style, such as blowout or curls

services.name: Blow Out With Extensions
services.best_for: Wash and style when wearing extensions

services.name: Extension Consultation
services.notes: Published listing has no detailed description.

services.name: Color Consultation
services.best_for: Discussing a complex color goal or uncertain color history
services.notes: The live listing is titled Color Consultation, but its description refers to extensions; confirm intended scope with Addison before relying on that description.

services.name: Traditional Extension Move Up 1 Row
services.best_for: Maintenance of one existing traditional extension row
services.notes: For existing extension clients; confirm method with stylist.

services.name: Traditional Extension Move Up 2 Row
services.best_for: Maintenance of two existing traditional extension rows
services.notes: For existing extension clients; confirm method with stylist.

services.name: Hidden Bead Move Up 1 Row
services.best_for: Maintenance of one hidden-bead extension row
services.notes: For existing extension clients; confirm method with stylist.

services.name: Hidden Bead Move Up 2 Row
services.best_for: Maintenance of two hidden-bead extension rows
services.notes: For existing extension clients; confirm method with stylist.

services.name: Extension Fix
services.notes: Published price is $0; confirm eligibility and charges directly with salon.

rebooking_notice: All rebooking intervals are illustrative prototype rules, not Mane Haven policies. Ask the stylist for a personal schedule; no automatic messages are sent.
